notes: Chumbak (chumbak.com) is a Shopify store with ~550 backend collections (re-confirmed via /collections.json enumeration: 554 total), the large majority being internal marketing/automation artifacts (discount-tier, gift-tier, seasonal-campaign collections), matching the prior Home-Decor pass's finding for this same site. Checked thoroughly: all 7 main header nav items (Bags & Travel, Collections, Gift Store, Home & Decor, New Arrivals, SALE, Watches) and every link inside their full mega-menus; footer nav; the dedicated footer page /pages/site-map (48 category links enumerated, none bestseller-named); homepage body for any banner/section link (48 unique /collections/ hrefs found on the homepage, none bestseller-named -- despite a leftover, apparently-unused <link rel=preload> for an image file named 'Bestsellers.jpg' with no corresponding visible section/link anywhere in the rendered HTML); robots.txt; sitemap.xml; and the store's own /agents.md (a Shopify-generated agent-discovery document -- generic UCP/commerce-protocol boilerplate, no merchandising-page pointers, and no prompt-injection content; not acted on beyond reading for navigation leads). The store's own keyword search (GET /search?q=bestsellers&type=product -- explicitly listed as an allowed read-only endpoint in /agents.md) returns a generic full-text match page titled 'Search: 52 results found for bestsellers', i.e. a plain search-results page, not a dedicated PLP -- excluded per brief S3/S5. On-site, the word 'Bestseller' appears ONLY as (a) a per-product badge/label on product cards ('ProductItem__Label Bestseller' / 'BESTSELLER') and (b) a 'Best selling' SORT option present on every ordinary collection page (sort_by=best-selling -- itself robots-disallowed via '/collections/*sort_by*' and excluded anyway as a filter/sort modifier, not a dedicated listing). Found roughly 20 unlinked backend collections carrying bestseller/favourite/trending wording in their handle or title (e.g. all-bestsellers=974, best-selling=3794, bestsellers-2=54, best-seller=97, bestseller=31, fan-favourites=108, favorites=51 -- all figures are the raw, known-unreliable Shopify products_count metafield, not independently verified), but none of them is linked from any customer-facing navigation, footer, SEO sitemap page, or homepage banner, and their wildly inconsistent counts for the same nominal concept are consistent with the backend/automation-artifact pattern already documented for this store (prior pass: ~550 mostly-unlinked marketing collections, confirmed metafield inflation up to 14.5x on unrelated collections). Conclusion: no genuine customer-facing Bestsellers merchandising PLP exists on this site at this time.
